label: Bible Study
prompt: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the _____ is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favour to men of skill; but time and chance happeneth to them all.
verse: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favour to men of skill; but time and chance happeneth to them all.
note: The swift don't always win, nor the strong — time and chance happen to everyone.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And this is the record, that God hath given to us _____ life, and this life is in his Son.
verse: And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
note: The gospel in a sentence: God gave us eternal life, and that life is found in His Son.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And after a time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion: and, behold, there was a swarm of _____ and honey in the carcase of the lion.
verse: And after a time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion: and, behold, there was a swarm of bees and honey in the carcase of the lion.
note: Back at the lion's carcass, Samson found a swarm of bees and honey — the secret behind his famous riddle.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without _____ and without spot:
verse: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:
note: Peter's ransom price: not silver or gold, but blood — the perfect lamb, without a single defect.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And he was afraid, and said, How _____ is this place! this is none other but the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.
verse: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful is this place! this is none other but the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.
note: Jacob woke from the ladder dream: 'How dreadful is this place!' — dread as holy awe at the very gate of heaven.
